blocks.title: Physical-digital twin loop — Predictive Maintenance & Asset Intelligence
blocks.note: The twin is only as good as its last synchronization; drift is measured on a schedule and flagged rather than trusted.

blocks.x: The reference pattern behind Predictive Maintenance & Asset Intelligence is boring on purpose: contracts at every boundary, an owner per component, and evidence captured where the work happens. Boring architecture is what survives contact with an audit.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Predictive Maintenance & Asset Intelligence capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
